query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.category = 'office products' AND p.ref_id = r.ref_id WHERE p.status = 'archived' AND r.verified = 1) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.category = 'office products' AND p.ref_id = r.ref_id WHERE p.status = 'archived'), 1)
